title: The Hidden Skill Ear Training Builds in Every Composer
description:
Love game music but don't know what to learn next? Start with the free 6-Level roadmap: https://www.bestmusiccoach.com/roadmap?htrafficsource=yt-vgmc-clips&el=the-hidden-skill-ear-training-builds-in-every-composer

You develop several sub skills with your training. In addition to being able to identify things by ear, understand what's going on when you listen to a piece of music, you're also increasing your skill of critical listening. And the skill of critical listening is being able to hear a bunch of notes all together and then actually perform a magic trick in your mind where you're able to separate them out. You're able to say, okay, hear all the notes, and now separating them out, that's what we're working on here. And that's why doing harmonic intervals, especially at the beginning, can be significantly more of a challenge than doing melodic intervals when they're separated.
